verdict.rationale: Pulley documents reflecting vesting acceleration (pulley-docs-31) and stopping vesting on termination (pulley-docs-32). Its email alerts whenever a holder reaches a new vesting event (pulley-docs-37) imply the platform tracks vesting progress automatically. However, nothing in the pack shows ops users defining custom schedules with cliffs or milestones, or that acceleration triggers automatically on exit rather than being entered by hand. Missing for 10: evidence of custom vesting schedule builder, cliff configuration, milestone/performance-based vesting, exit-triggered (single/double-trigger) acceleration, explicit vested vs unvested reporting views, and independent hands-on corroboration.
